chapter.summary_en: Chapter 6: The Yoga of Meditation — 47 verses
chapter.colophon_sa: इति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासु उपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे ध्यानयोगः नाम 6ोऽध्यायः ॥ 6 ॥

verses.speaker: krishna
verses.deva:
श्री भगवानुवाच

अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः।

स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः।।6.1।।
verses.iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca

anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ|

sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ||6.1||
verses.en: He who performs his bounden duty without leaning to the fruit of action —he is a renouncer of action as well as of steadfast mind: not he who is without fire, nor he who is without action.

verses.deva:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव।

न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन।।6.2।।
verses.iast:
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava|

na hyasaṃnyastasaṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana||6.2||
verses.en: Know that to be devotion to action, which is called renunciation, O Pândava, for none becomes a devotee to action without forsaking Sankalpa.

verses.deva:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते।

योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते।।6.3।।
verses.iast:
ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate|

yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate||6.3||
verses.en: For the man of meditation wishing to attain purification of heart leading to concentration, work is said to be the way: For him, when he has attained such (concentration), inaction is said to be the way.

word_meanings.meaning: of those who are elevated in Yog

verses.deva:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।

सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते।।6.4।।
verses.iast:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate|

sarvasaṅkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate||6.4||
verses.en: Verily, when there is no attachment, either to sense-objects, or to actions, having renounced all Sankalpas, then is one said to have attained concentration.

word_meanings.meaning: all desires for the fruits of actions
elevated in the science of Yog

verses.deva:
उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।

आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः।।6.5।।
verses.iast:
uddharedātmanā''tmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet|

ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ||6.5||
verses.en: A man should uplift himself by his own self, so let him not weaken this self. For this self is the friend of oneself, and this self is the enemy of oneself.

verses.deva:
बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।

अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्।।6.6।।
verses.iast:
bandhurātmā''tmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ|

anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat||6.6||
verses.en: The self (the active part of our nature) is the friend of the self, for him who has conquered himself by this self. But to the unconquered self, this self is inimical, (and behaves) like (an external) foe.

verses.deva:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।

शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः।।6.7।।
verses.iast:
jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ|

śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ||6.7||
verses.en: To the self-controlled and serene, the Supreme Self is, the object of constant, realisation, in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honour and dishonour.

word_meanings.meaning: one who has conquered one’s mind

verses.deva:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।

युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।।6.8।।
verses.iast:
jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ|

yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ||6.8||
verses.en: Whose heart is filled with satisfaction by wisdom and realisation, and is changeless, whose senses are conquered, and to whom a lump of earth, stone, and gold are the same: that Yogi is called steadfast.

word_meanings.meaning: one who has conquered the senses
one who is in constant communion with the Supreme

verses.deva:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।

साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते।।6.9।।
verses.iast:
suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu|

sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate||6.9||
verses.en: He attains excellence who looks with equal regard upon well-wishers, friends, foes, neutrals, arbiters, the hateful, the relatives, and upon the righteous and the unrighteous alike.

verses.deva:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः।

एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः।।6.10।।
verses.iast:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ|

ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ||6.10||
verses.en: The Yogi should constantly practise concentration of the heart, retiring into solitude, alone, with the mind and body subdued, and free from hope and possession.

word_meanings.meaning: with a controlled mind and body
free from desires for possessions for enjoyment

verses.deva:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः।

नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्।।6.11।।
verses.iast:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ|

nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram||6.11||
verses.en: Having in a cleanly spot established his seat, firm, neither too high nor too low, made of a cloth, a skin, and Kusha-grass, arranged in consecution:

verses.deva:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः।

उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये।।6.12।।
verses.iast:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ|

upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye||6.12||
verses.en: There, seated on that seat, making the mind one-pointed and subduing the action of the imaging faculty and the senses, let him practise Yoga for the purification of the heart.

verses.deva:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।

संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्।।6.13।।
verses.iast:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ|

saṃprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan||6.13||
verses.en: Let him firmly hold his body, head and neck erect and still, (with the eye-balls fixed, as if) gazing at the tip of his nose, and not looking around.

word_meanings.meaning: at the tip of the nose

verses.deva:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः।

मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः।।6.14।।
verses.iast:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ|

manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ||6.14||
verses.en: With the heart serene and fearless, firm in the vow of a Brahmachâri, with the mind controlled, and ever thinking of Me, let him sit (in Yoga) having Me as his supreme goal.

word_meanings.meaning: having me as the supreme goal

verses.deva:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः।

शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति।।6.15।।
verses.iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadā''tmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ|

śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati||6.15||
verses.en: Thus always keeping the mind steadfast, the Yogi of subdued mind attains the peace residing in Me,—the peace which culminates in Nirvâna (Moksha).

word_meanings.meaning: keeping the mind absorbed in God

verses.deva:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः।

न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन।।6.16।।
verses.iast:
nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ|

na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna||6.16||
verses.en: (Success in) Yoga is not for him who eats too much or too little—nor, O Arjuna, for him who sleeps too much or too little.

word_meanings.meaning: of one who does not sleep enough

verses.deva:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।

युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा।।6.17।।
verses.iast:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu|

yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā||6.17||
verses.en: To him who is temperate in eating and recreation, in his effort for work, and in sleep and wakefulness, Yoga becomes the destroyer of misery.

verses.deva:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते।

निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा।।6.18।।
verses.iast:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate|

niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā||6.18||
verses.en: When the completely controlled mind rests serenely in the Self alone, free from longing after all desires, then is one called steadfast, (in the Self).

verses.deva:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।

योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः।।6.19।।
verses.iast:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā|

yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ||6.19||
verses.en: "As a lamp in a spot sheltered from the wind does not flicker,"—even such has been the simile used for a Yogi of subdued mind, practising concentration in the Self.

verses.deva:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया।

यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति।।6.20।।
verses.iast:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā|

yatra caivātmanā''tmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati||6.20||
verses.en: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

verses.deva:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्।

वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः।।6.21।।
verses.iast:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattadbuddhigrāhyamatīndriyam|

vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ||6.21||
verses.en: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

verses.deva:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः।

यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते।।6.22।।
verses.iast:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ|

yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate||6.22||
verses.en: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

verses.deva:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्।

स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा।।6.23।।
verses.iast:
taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam|

sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā||6.23||
verses.en: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

word_meanings.meaning: state of severance from union with misery

verses.deva:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।

मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः।।6.24।।
verses.iast:
saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ|

manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ||6.24||
verses.en: Abandoning without reserve all desires born of Sankalpa, and completely restraining, by the mind alone, the whole group of senses from their objects in all directions;

verses.deva:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया।

आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्।।6.25।।
verses.iast:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā|

ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet||6.25||
verses.en: With the intellect set in patience, with the mind fastened on the Self, let him attain quietude by degrees: let him not think of anything.

word_meanings.meaning: achieved through determination of resolve that is in accordance with scriptures

verses.deva:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।

ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्।।6.26।।
verses.iast:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram|

tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet||6.26||
verses.en: Through whatever reason the restless, unsteady mind wanders away, let him curbing it from that, bring it under the subjugation of the Self alone.

verses.deva:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्।

उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्।।6.27।।
verses.iast:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam|

upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam||6.27||
verses.en: Verily, the supreme bliss comes to that Yogi, of perfectly tranquil mind, with passions quieted, Brahman-become, and freed from taint.

verses.deva:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।

सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते।।6.28।।
verses.iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadā''tmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ|

sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute||6.28||
verses.en: The Yogi freed from taint (of good and evil), constantly engaging the mind thus, with ease attains the infinite bliss of contact with Brahman.

word_meanings.meaning: constantly in touch with the Supreme

verses.deva:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि।

ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः।।6.29।।
verses.iast:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani|

īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ||6.29||
verses.en: With the heart concentrated by Yoga, with the eye of evenness for all things, he beholds the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self.

word_meanings.meaning: one united in consciousness with God

verses.deva:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति।

तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति।।6.30।।
verses.iast:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati|

tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati||6.30||
verses.en: He who sees Me in all things, and sees all things in Me, he never becomes separated from Me, nor do I become separated from him.

verses.deva:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।

सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते।।6.31।।
verses.iast:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ|

sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate||6.31||
verses.en: He who being established in unity, worships Me, who am dwelling in all beings, whatever his mode of life, that Yogi abides in Me.

verses.deva:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन।

सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः।।6.32।।
verses.iast:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna|

sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ saḥ yogī paramo mataḥ||6.32||
verses.en: He who judges of pleasure or pain everywhere, by the same standard as he applies to himself, that Yogi, O Arjuna, is regarded as the highest.

verses.speaker: arjuna
verses.deva:
अर्जुन उवाच

योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन।

एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्।।6.33।।
verses.iast:
arjuna uvāca

yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana|

etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvāt sthitiṃ sthirām||6.33||
verses.en: This Yoga which has been taught by Thee, O slayer of Madhu, as characterised by evenness, I do not see (the possibility of) its lasting endurance, owing to restlessness (of the mind).

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, the killer of the demon named Madhu

verses.deva:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।

तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्।।6.34।।
verses.iast:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavaddṛḍham|

tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram||6.34||
verses.en: Verily, the mind, O Krishna, is restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding;. I regard it quite as hard to achieve its control, as that of the wind.

verses.speaker: krishna
verses.deva:
श्री भगवानुवाच

असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं।

अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।।6.35।।
verses.iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca

asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calaṃ|

abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate||6.35||
verses.en: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is restless, and difficult to control; but through practice and renunciation, O son of Kunti, it may be governed.

verses.deva:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः।

वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः।।6.36।।
verses.iast:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ|

vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ||6.36||
verses.en: Yoga is hard to be attained by one of uncontrolled self: such is My conviction; but by him who has controlled himself, it can be attained by striving through proper means. This is My conviction.

word_meanings.meaning: by one whose mind is controlled

verses.speaker: arjuna
verses.deva:
अर्जुन उवाच

अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः।

अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति।।6.37।।
verses.iast:
arjuna uvāca

ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ|

aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati||6.37||
verses.en: Though possessed of Shraddhâ but unable to control himself, with the mind wandering away from Yoga, what end does one, failing to gain perfection in Yoga, meet, O Krishna?

verses.deva:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति।

अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि।।6.38।।
verses.iast:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati|

apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi||6.38||
verses.en: Does he not, fallen from both, perish, without support, like a rent cloud, O mighty-armed, deluded in the path of Brahman?

verses.deva:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः।

त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते।।6.39।।
verses.iast:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ|

tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate||6.39||
verses.en: This doubt of mine, O Krishna, Thou shouldst completely dispel; for it is not possible for any but Thee to dispel this doubt.

verses.speaker: krishna
verses.deva:
श्री भगवानुवाच

पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।

नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्िचद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति।।6.40।।
verses.iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca

pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate|

nahi kalyāṇakṛtkaśicaddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati||6.40||
verses.en: Verily, O son of Prithâ, there is destruction for him, neither here nor hereafter: for, the doer of good, O my son, never comes to grief.

verses.deva:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।

शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते।।6.41।।
verses.iast:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ|

śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate||6.41||
verses.en: Having attained to the worlds of the righteous, and dwelling there for everlasting years, one fallen from Yoga reincarnates in the home of the pure and the prosperous.

verses.deva:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्।

एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्।।6.42।।
verses.iast:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām|

etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam||6.42||
verses.en: Or else he is born into a family of wise Yogis only; verily, a birth such as that is very rare to obtain in this world.

word_meanings.meaning: of those endowed with divine wisdom

verses.deva:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्।

यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन।।6.43।।
verses.iast:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam|

yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana||6.43||
verses.en: There he is united with the intelligence acquired in his former body, and strives more than before, for perfection, O son of the Kurus.

verses.deva:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः।

जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते।।6.44।।
verses.iast:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ|

jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate||6.44||
verses.en: By that previous practice alone, he is borne on in spite of himself. Even the enquirer after Yoga rises superior to the performer of Vedic actions.

verses.deva:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः।

अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।6.45।।
verses.iast:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ|

anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim||6.45||
verses.en: The Yogi, striving assiduously, purified of taint, gradually gaining perfection through many births, then reaches the highest goal.

verses.deva:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।

कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन।।6.46।।
verses.iast:
tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ|

karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna||6.46||
verses.en: The Yogi is regarded as superior to those who practise asceticism, also to those who have obtained wisdom (through the Shâstras). He is also superior to the performers of action, (enjoined in the Vedas). Therefore, be thou a Yogi, O Arjuna!

verses.deva:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।

श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः।।6.47।।
verses.iast:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā|

śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ||6.47||
verses.en: And of all Yogis, he who with the inner self merged in Me, with Shraddhâ devotes himself to Me, is considered by Me the most steadfast.
